candidate_target: abnormal operation with a provider reference; cross-equipment interpretation remains conditional

smart_pdm.scope: appliance maintenance state, not a confirmed compressor-specific diagnosis
smart_pdm.physical_equipment_id: unknown; cycles are not independent devices

kaist.scope: selected normal/induced outer-bearing condition on a rotating-machine bench
kaist.unselected_diagnoses: not imported or silently mapped by this version
kaist.groups: all channels/windows/conditions at the same selected load remain together

rwth_r290.reason: refrigerant charge and operating frequency are conditions, not independent binary failure labels

ult_freezers.reason: service-request date does not identify the true onset/extent of faulty minutes; absence of an event is not normality proof
ult_freezers.groups: provider freezer identity; preserve controller/header discrepancies

transfer.rule: Clusters and unusual values propose hypotheses; preserve reference labels and require independent target evidence before accepting a derived label.
